## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Apply the 12-character minimum to invite passwords before merging so the invite flow enforces the stated security policy.

## Changes

The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimums from 8 to 12 characters and updates both boundary tests. It also adds `review.txt`.

## Critical

- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Enforce the 12-character minimum for invite passwords — An 8-character password still passes invite validation through the separate minimum at `app/invite.py:1` after signup and reset move to 12. The invite boundary test explicitly expects that input to pass. — Users accepting an invitation can set passwords below the stated security minimum. — Fix: Raise the minimum at `app/invite.py:1` and update `test_password_boundaries` at `tests/test_invite.py:6`.
